data: Overall, very solid game well worth the asking price
Super satisfying and the story is very fun to follow
Overall, it is a great game, with lots to do and tons of content
Great game, I cant stop playing this so relaxing and best while listening to music or watching videos
Very satisfying and relaxing, and great fun with friends
and its just not worth the money for the DLC

great game to train your patience . turn on some gameplay to watch / listen to spotify / talk to your friends etc while playing this is really calming. this game thought me a lot of patience to tolerate stupid people 10/10

I completed the story mode 100% and during that time I managed to get through a bunch of movies, TV series like Dexter, some anime and plenty of YouTube videos. I recommend buying this game if you’re the kind of person who cant just sit and watch something and prefers having an extra activity to stay occupied while watching

Not exactly a subversive masterpiece this game is pretty simple.
Step 1: I saw a dirty thing.
Step 2: I washed it.
Step 3: Profit.

They add content every once in a while and theres quite a few levels and challenges. Worth the price 100%

This game showed me how short my attention span is. Don't judge my cleaning lines. The job will get done... eventually.

No but seriously, If you wanna waste a few hours coasting with some music playing in the background, this is perfect.

The perfect game to turn on some relaxing music, kick back, and just rot in your seat cleaning virtually. You can easily lose track of time playing..

and, for some reason oddly satisfying to just spray everything.

Warning: power wash videos may pop up on your Instagram feed after playing, and all you can really think about is.. wow. why isn't this in the game as a level?

I have cleared every normal and special board. Love this game and would highly recommend if you like casual games. It is calming and satisfying. My only complaint is that it needs more boards/levels or whatever they would like to call it.

if i could get paid to powerwash things all day, outside of the video game, i would take it in a heartbeat. alternatively if every time i completed a task or got paid a little DING sound played i feel like i would be a happier human being.
this game is soothing and satisfying to the little goblin in my brain who likes things to be clean but struggles to clean their actual room. heed all warnings about this game ruining sleep schedules: they're right.
If only cleaning in real life was this fun. Great to play with a friend and just zen.

This game is extremely satisfying. Excellent when you just want to relax or you need to fill time while you wait for the next big thing.

Try not to sink 18 hours into it in one day though; your friends might worry about your sanity.

Definitely one of the most fun I've had playing a game like this.
I don't need to worry about a water meter, I don't need to worry about a day/night cycle, I don't need to worry about stuff bothering me, I don't gotta worry about fall damage, it's just me and what I have left to clean.

Surprisingly, there is a storyline. It's not intrusive, but it's nice to have some lore going on.

I can only recommend this game for people who are looking for the perfect game to just not have to worry about anything but running your washer. This game is very tedious and repetitive. But, it is fun.

Enjoy this game. It has elements of a FPS (with the washer), a weir story that you can just ignore… and the power washing is somehow extremely satisfying. I enjoyed it on steam deck. Be prepared to highlight dirty areas a lot on the small screen.

it is a good for anxiety people to play this game .
i have very bad anxiety , so i play the game clam me down and it work and keep me focus on game and not my anxiety.
so the powerwash game is pretty good to chill out on.
A fun, easy game for all! wonderful DLC, partial customization with the suites/power washers, interesting cleaning jobs etc. It's very satisfying to see the end result as well!
It's challenging in it's own way but it's so very fun to find every single piece of dirt. I would recommend this game. 100% would recommend.

After learning about the "backstory" by Game Theory a few years ago, I just wanted a chill game. Who would have thought that my female brain would love a cleaning game. I play for maybe an hour at a time and feel relaxed after a stressful day.

i started playing this game after watching youtuber Markiplier play through a few levels and this has been the best use of my money ever. I suffer from anxiety and depression and these levels have been calming and cathartic whenever i feel i'm about to have an attack. i always feel i can relax whether playing for 5 minutes or 50. i can't wait to see what future updates have in store!
Is entertaining and fun. Can be difficult to find grime spots - but otherwise is repetitive (in a way that is good) and reliable for the task/s at hand

I truly can't think of another game that brought me this much peace and joy. Being able to silently clean the dirt off of homes and vehicles brought me to a moment of zen I hadn't experienced in nearly 10 years. My world was calm, each mission melting away a layer of dirt that life had stacked upon me. I got fired from my job for thinking about this game all day but that is okay. I have PowerWash Simulator now, and that's all I need.
I'm going to clean this house and not question the stains at all, not even all the red splatters on the ground leading inside.
I love this Game it is very satisfying and fun to play with my friends i just wish there was a way for everyone to buy and use their own soap and not just the hos t of the sever.

I love this. This game is the embodiment of satisfaction, and/or asmr. The thing I love most is that there is no 'good enough'. You have to get every little speck of dirt, which I think is amazing attention to detail. If you love satisfying things, this is the game for you.

When I am sad I play power wash simulator.
When I am angry I play power wash simulator.
When I am confused I play power wash simulator.
When I am stressed I play power wash simulator.
When I am happy I play power wash simulator.
When I am contemplating life I play power wash simulator.
I really like playing power wash simulator.
Their DLCs crossovers are quite random to the point where I wouldn't be surprised if they did one with Sam & Max

Excellent game to zone out to while listening to audiobooks! Very satisfying to play and I've enjoyed all the DLC additions that have come out so far! PC is definitely the correct platform for this game, precision-wise, I've logged many hours on the Switch version I got first, and let me tell you, SO much easier to control using the mouse!

This game... this game.

Never before have I experienced something so gratifying and rewarding as that final ding when you clean that final speck of dirt. This game has perfected it's craft. It is a triumph of design. In a world of unfinished and disappointing releases, one game shines as a beacon of quality and grace. Powerwashing Simulator.

"Why do you play this?" People ask me, but the real question is: why don't you?

This game is one I absolutely love.

Life for me recently has just been constant stress, and I've felt consistently on edge for the last month or so.
However, this game is an amazing escape from that. Boot up the game, put a youtube video on, and take a small break.
There's no urgency to this game(aside from challenge mode), and it's just given me some time to relax. Instead of worrying about stuff I shouldn't be, I'm trying to clean up a building, a vehicle, or something of those sorts.
Great game when you need to relax.

This game was a perfect fit for my end-of-day stress relief. Turn on some Kitboga, jump into a lobby with a friend, and just zone out for a few hours. My only complaint is the absurd lack of content once you beat Career Mode. Literally nothing to do. No DLC, no customer maps, nothing. Have been waiting nearly a year to get back to washing but alas, still no map updates. Hope one day they'll offer more content but until then, going back to wasting time in other games.
Such a fun, relaxing game. 10/10 and the regular updates and DLC's have only made me appreciate this game more!

Ultra satisfying game with a lot of cool locations/vehicles to clean! Also really good if you like to multitask while you play. Listening to music or podcasts while power-washing makes the time just fly by.

I love love love this game! It's huge on detail and so calming. And that *ding* anytime you 100% something is just so GRATIFYING!
The Devs are really involved with their Community through Discord, and always sending out new Levels and Challenges in updates.
Can't recommend this enough. So satisfying.

Really fun and relaxing game, with 1 glaring issue.

If you play the entire time with someone in career mode, and decide to go back and do some free play with them later, their tools are restricted to their own career progress which is none if they've spent their entire time playing with you in career mode. So their tools are not really strong enough to do more than the basic levels easily.

Free play is restricted to individuals progress, and career mode allows the hosts progress to be shared w the lobby. Seems backwards. Career mode should progress for all involved, and free play shouldn't really have any restrictions at all, since its not affecting career mode.

I do recommend the game, as its a great time, but this 1 issue severely limits group play with friends.

Got 40 hours to burn? Need to watch that new anime series while fulfilling your monthly dopamine quota? Buy this game. Have something in the background and watch a giant piece of s**t area turn into something wonderful. Then look at your own room and start playing again...
This is a nice and relaxing game, following a storyline of the Mayor's cat that went missing. i am enjoying this game while listening to reddit stories :)

At first I was afraid to buy it because seemed like a silly game. It may be, but oh, how much fun I had! I had to uninstall at multiple times because I was so focused on washing I couldn't get anything done. So, yes I recomend it but be aware.

Sadly the two player experience was weird.
I expected to jump in and play with my friend and have a satisfying relaxing experience of cleaning.
But instead there's two modes where you can play more than one player.
"Campaign" and "Freeplay", but freeplay only has maps that you've finished in Campaign so that wasn't an option. And in Campaign only the first player gets progress?
And the levels themselves take way longer than the quick satisfying experience I was expecting, the first couple of levels were ok but then it quickly got to over an hour of time to finish one map?
Just not the experience I was expecting.

I remember watching Smii7y playing this for the first time and i really thought it was cool. Now to say I've finished the campaign i was blown away by story game play and as well as the ending credits and cut scene were so heart touching and I don't know why i highly recommend this game if you want a solo or co-op game to just chill out and play Awesome job devs 10/10

I have played this game for a long time (kind of) and I really like it it's a relaxing and enjoyable game. If you want to just play a game for a while without smashing your keyboard every five seconds ad Call of Duty or something this is a game for you.

I absolutely love this game, I have spent multiple hours of my life both playing the career mode and redoing the same maps in free play to 100% the game on every new update. For the past few years I haven't been able to enjoy eating due to severe stomach pain and this game takes my mind off a painful stomach every now and then. I hope that they are able to add workshop maps at some point soon to allow me to enjoy more of this game as often as possible. Lastly I just want to say thank you to the developers for creating such a simplistic, fun, mind numbing game to take my mind off my issues I've been having. Support these guys as much as possible, always ready to see more from them :)
I would rather powerwash 10hr in this game than for 5 minutes in real life. The satisfaction this game provides and the brain juices that flow when I watch the dirt get removed is second to none.
played this for awhile on my ps5 and have over 200+ hrs, but its still a relaxing and fun game on her!!!
Very nice game to have some music on in the background and mindlessly play. Love this game, and can't wait until they release more into this game

Way more fun than it has any right to be.
Most simulator games are janky af, but power wash simulator completely breaks that mould, with smooth game play.
Super enjoyable, and relaxing to play. 10/10

x-- 7/10 --x

Fun, but can get very repetitive after a while. 
Still relaxing though

This is a very satisfying game that needs no sound. I personally like to listen to audio books or stories of entitled parents/people. 2 YouTube channels for these stories are "Am I the Jerk?" and "Scrubby" and or "Scrubs". you can also find Scrubby/Scrubs in podcast form on any platform under the name "The Scrubby Runnaway Podcast" which yes has 2 n's in Runnaway. This game can get a little boring at times but I also like to take a short video of the job before I do anything and after I'm done. It is very satisfying to see it perfectly clean and shiny afterwards. This is a game with amazing graphics, not super long loading times (the bigger the job the longer it takes to load), and overall tons of fun, satisfying game play! Thanks for reading my review!

One of the best games i've 100 percented in 2023 its relaxing, it's tedious and more importantly its fun.

The only thing i need to really say is that i made this town shine.

Very relaxing with some fun challenging objects to wash - although that ship nearly had me flipping desks. Would love to see some variations on the power washer heads/shapes and maybe some better options for climbing. Extremely satisfying game, 10/10!
the perfect no thoughts, head empty game. great for keeping you busy while you're hanging out in a vc or watching something. sobriety is optional
Been following this game since the original demo released and it's honestly the most relaxing game I have ever played in my life. Cleaning is stress relief.

its so satisfying and very grindy If u like really grindy games then its the one for you. Took me about 34 hours to complete everything as of now. The little bits of lore and the fact that new jobs could come out keeps me on my toes. Great game would definitely recommend; not the game for everyone though.

So... I know a lot of people really enjoy this game but... I just couldn't get into it. Get it if you enjoy Seeing Messes Get Cleaned by your own hand. Personal preference aside its a very nice and polished game with lost to do.

tldr.text: Overwhelmingly Positive (97%): players praise the price and enjoy the story and characters.
The main complaint is the price and monetization, which 6% of reviews raise.

details.text: Reviews from the last month are about as positive as the all-time score, at 95%.
Players in their first couple of hours are less positive, at 79%, than those who have played for many hours.
